_note: Strip Paintings. Gallery only ... none of these are on chain, so the collection carries gallery:true and every work carries tokenized:false and status not_tokenized. When a work is tokenized it gains a digital block and its status flips to available/acquired; nothing else here has to change. Images are local until scripts/import-strip-paintings.mjs puts them in R2 and rewrites `image` to the assets.mintface.art URL.

collection.title: Strip Paintings
collection.statement: Strip paintings over vacant fascia signage in Hastings CBD... colours sampled from the neighbouring streetscape. A red line runs through every one, sixteen strips from the base.
collection.notes: Not yet tokenized. These are on record here as a gallery ... no prices, nothing on offer. Each will be written to chain when it is, and the record graduates in place.
